verdict.rationale: Gmail's own docs describe Gemini built into Gmail as an assistant you can hand tasks to. It can summarize threads, draft and refine emails, propose meeting times from Google Calendar, and act on the mailbox, such as deleting multiple emails or adding labels. Suggested replies are marketed alongside these features. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated actions work reliably, and documentation of how far the agentic actions go (multi-step tasks, limits, plan availability).
